Eine Camera lucida spiegelt das Motiv au: A camera lucida mirrors the subject onto your paper – painters have used it to transfer outlines for over 200 years. LiCida does the same with your phone’s camera: modelled on the iOS app “Camera Lucida”, rebuilt for Android and designed following Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines.

Camera and template are now linked. Zoom up to 30×, focus, lock exposure – and trace.
